en.io: Input: .hyperflow task, spec, audit, and memory files. Output: one status block with active tasks, progress, branch fields when present, artifact counts, and memory count.
en.boundary: Read-only; it never edits files or runs work. If .hyperflow is absent, it only reports that condition and suggests scaffolding.

zh.io: 输入：.hyperflow 中的任务、规格、审计和记忆文件。输出：单个状态块，包含活动任务、进度、可用时的分支字段、产物计数和记忆计数。
zh.boundary: 完全只读，不编辑文件也不执行工作。.hyperflow 缺失时只报告该情况并建议初始化。
dependencies: 可读的 .hyperflow 目录和 Markdown 产物
